mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP indicates strong economic demand, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 60 days, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate suggests a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If unemployment is low but S&P 500 returns are negative, this hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: Rising CPI without corresponding increases in FEDFUNDS may signal inflationary pressures, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by 0.5% in one month without FEDFUNDS adjustment
failure_condition: Positive S&P 500 returns despite the CPI-FEDFUNDS condition indicates failure.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts indicate strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in the next 5 days.
failure_condition: Negative returns despite increased housing starts would falsify this hypothesis.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in industrial production suggests strong supply, positively impacting S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Negative returns with growing industrial production would invalidate this hypothesis.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales indicate strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Negative returns despite retail sales growth would falsify this hypothesis.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment in late-cycle expansion may lead to negative S&P 500 returns due to potential economic slowdown.
failure_condition: Positive returns in this regime would invalidate the hypothesis.

mechanism_narrative: Rising FEDFUNDS alongside slowing GDP growth may signal economic tightening, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases while GDPC1 growth slows
failure_condition: Positive returns despite the FEDFUNDS-GDP condition would falsify this hypothesis.
